description: Prefix-equal to sf-win-09 through frame 37154 (Sagat round-1 fight-loop start), then two block-high holds (cycles 295..296, 37155..37200) and a Shoryuken HP cadence (cycles 297..324, 37309..39009, period 62, walk 12, offset 18) that exercise Sagat's Tiger Shot spawn (0x45ace -> 0x1873c), blocked Tiger Shot chip damage (0x43652 -> 0x436b0 and explosion 0x186fc at 37187), unblocked Tiger Shot hit with slow motion event 9 (0x43652 -> 0x436a8 and explosion 0x186fc at 37292), and normal hit functions (0x47ff4, 0x480d0, 0x47f86), win round 1 at 37645 and round 2 at 39009, run Sagat's match-won card (0x159b2, voice 0xba, 39406..39676) and wipe (event 6, 39677..39774), enter the ending 0x44a40 at 39776 (0x44a60), and run the entire ending (5 country scenes, congratulatory text, and 8-page staff roll) through 0x3efc4 (stage 4 -> 5 at 43617) into 0x3f2d0 / 0x42422 name entry (43617..43618).

reference.notes: US set 1, six-button controls; MAME set sf. ROM set verified by mame -verifyroms against the pinned build.
